document.title: Summary of Benefits 2027, Humana Gold Plus H1036-068 (HMO)
document.read_with: pdftotext -layout; pages counted in the PDF, which equal the printed page numbers. Part D on pages 4 (deductible), 11 (initial coverage), 12 (insulin, catastrophic coverage, excluded drugs) and 13 (long-term care, out of network).

status: Written 2026-10-24, before the Part D importer; run on the golden file since the importer read the Part D files (2026-10-24), by scripts/from-pbp.test.js: 46 checks, 45 MATCH, 1 READING, 0 DIFFERENCE. checks.printed: After your total out-of-pocket costs reach $2,400 you pay $0 for plan-covered Part D and Excluded drugs. (Excluded drugs: ED drugs and prescription vitamins, "Select drugs covered at Tier 1 cost-share amount".)
checks.note: The page's excluded-drug figure after the threshold is $0. checks.item: Over-the-Counter (OTC) mail order, quarterly allowance
checks.printed: $90 quarterly allowance to buy approved over-the-counter health and wellness products available through our OTC Mail Order provider.
checks.note: Added 2026-10-28. The file states the allowance in Section D, as a combined supplemental benefit group: pbp_d_combo_grp_name_1 "OTC Max Allowance", pbp_d_combo_nmc_cats_1 "13b;18c;", pbp_d_combo_max_plan_ben_amt_1 "90.00", pbp_d_combo_max_plan_period_1 "5"; 13b itself answers pbp_b13b_maxplan_yn "2". The Medicare Advantage importer writes it with shared_limit_id PBP_D_COMBO_1 (docs/specs/pbp-importer.md section 5.9).

checks.item: Over-the-Counter (OTC) mail order, unused allowance
checks.printed: Unused amount rolls over to the next quarter and expires at the end of the plan year.
checks.note: Added 2026-10-28. No combined supplemental benefit group column states a carryover, and 13b's own pbp_b13b_maxplan_prd_yn is blank because 13b answers pbp_b13b_maxplan_yn "2", so the limit has no carryover (docs/specs/pbp-importer.md section 5.9).
